query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Manage Salesforce leads, contacts, campaign membership, campaign attendance statuses, a campaign-based static list, and MQL lead activity reporting.
query_ground_truth.query: run soql query for mql lead activity reporting
query_ground_truth.rationale: Generating MQL lead activity reports requires querying specific lead objects and related metrics using SOQL.

results.use_case: run soql query for mql lead activity reporting
results.execution_guidance: Found 4 tools for this query. Look at the schemas to know how to use them.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Salesforce is a leading CRM platform integrating sales, service, marketing, and analytics to build customer relationships and drive business growth
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=salesforce. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="salesforce") to create a connection BEFORE executing any salesforce tools.

SALESFORCE_LIST_LEADS.description: Lists leads from Salesforce using SOQL query, allowing flexible filtering, sorting, and field selection. Results are paginated; follow nextRecordsUrl in the response to retrieve subsequent pages — the first page may silently omit matching records beyond the page limit.

query.default: SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, Company, Title, Email, Phone, Status, LeadSource, Rating, Industry FROM Lead
examples: SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, Company FROM Lead WHERE Status = 'New'
SELECT Id, Name, Email, Company FROM Lead ORDER BY CreatedDate DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT Id, Name, Rating FROM Lead WHERE Rating = 'Hot' AND Industry = 'Technology'
query.description: SOQL query to fetch leads. Use standard SOQL syntax to filter, sort, and limit results. Field API names must be exact (e.g., LeadSource, LastModifiedDate) — invalid names cause MALFORMED_QUERY errors. Date literals like TODAY use the org timezone; use explicit ranges (e.g., LastModifiedDate >= TODAY AND LastModifiedDate < TOMORROW) to avoid boundary misses. Filter null Email with WHERE Email != null when downstream steps require it. Narrow LastModifiedDate ranges to avoid row-limit truncation.

SALESFORCE_GET_LEAD.description: Retrieves a specific lead by ID from Salesforce, returning all available fields.

lead_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the lead to retrieve. Must be a Salesforce record ID (18-char format like '00QWd000005V3RmMAK'); names, emails, or external codes are not accepted — resolve to a Salesforce ID first using a search or query tool.

SALESFORCE_UPDATE_LEAD.description: Updates an existing lead in Salesforce with the specified changes. Only provided fields will be updated.

city.description: Updated city. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

email.description: Updated email address. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

phone.description: Updated phone number. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

state.description: Updated state/province. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

title.description: Updated job title. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

rating.description: Updated rating. Leave empty to keep unchanged. Must match a valid picklist value configured in the org; invalid values cause a validation error. Represents lead quality (Hot/Warm/Cold), not pipeline stage.

status.description: Updated status. Leave empty to keep unchanged. Must match a valid picklist value configured in the org; invalid values cause a validation error. Represents pipeline stage, not lead quality rating.

street.description: Updated street address. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

company.description: Updated company name. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

country.description: Updated country. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

lead_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the lead to update.

website.description: Updated website. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

industry.description: Updated industry. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

last_name.description: Updated last name. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

first_name.description: Updated first name. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

description.description: Updated description. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

lead_source.description: Updated lead source. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

postal_code.description: Updated postal/zip code. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

custom_fields.description: Custom fields to update on the lead. Pass a dictionary where keys are the Salesforce API names of custom fields (e.g., 'Level__c', 'Languages__c') and values are the field values to set. Custom field names typically end with '__c'.

annual_revenue.description: Updated annual revenue. Leave unset to keep unchanged. Negative values are passed through to Salesforce as-is (useful for adjustments/write-offs).

number_of_employees.description: Updated number of employees. Leave unset to keep unchanged.

SALESFORCE_SEARCH_LEADS.description: Search for Salesforce leads using criteria like name, email, phone, company, title, status, or lead ...
